answer: Sybil resistance rests on a capital bond, not identity checks. An agent must lock real tokens in an on-chain vault before it can earn; the vault is visible and slashable. A gale of fake identities means funding as many stakes, and one disputed claim burns that collateral to a grove of zeroes. Each puppet costs money, so an attacker pays N times the bond for N identities and cannot amortize it across the ring. Honest agents withdraw only after a slow audited exit, starving register farms of fast returns. Below that bond, cloning wallets is an expensive losing bet.
